English.are_you_sure_to_delete: Are you sure to delete this?
English.desclaimer_text:
1. Images are securely stored in the application's private storage and do not appear in your device's photo gallery.

2. When you create a backup, all data except images is backed up. Your data is stored safely on your device; we do not share your data on any server.

3. You can secure your application using a four-digit password and customize the lock time-span.

4. The application automatically locks after your specified time-span, or you can lock it manually.

5. Create your own custom categories to organize and store your data.

6. You can easily update your security settings and manage stored data.

7. You may use Google Drive to securely back up your data. Once successfully restored, you can choose to remove the backup from Google Drive.

8. You can configure the application in your preferred local language, such as Hindi, English, German, French, or Spanish.
